DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and Cordis 4.1 co"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"mpatibility. The package uses the host's matching services; no version exemption

Test"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ed with Google's
server **1.3.0** on Windows x64; fake-server CI covers Windows, Linux and macOS.
Au"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"tomatic downloads support all three operating systems on x64 and arm64."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"In DSH's plugin manager, install using the repository URL:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"https://github.com/dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"For a terminal installation:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Open the profile and send a message. fully quit DSH and"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" reopen it: an open host can retain the previous plugin module

there is no update button, remove the plugin and install th"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"e same repository URL

Th"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"e package bundle mounts the provider and default model. Explicit saved
profile/session selections re"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"tain DSH's normal precedence. You can choose any
announced model in the ordinary model picker."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The built dist is committed so Git installation needs no compiler. The package
uses the host's llm a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"nd subprocess services without editing DSH core or a global
installation. Development checkout:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How tools work"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Tool schemas are exported automatically to the bridge. A validated MCP request
becomes an ordinary D"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"SH tool-call block, using its original name and arguments.
The MCP request stays pending while the D"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"SH agent loop executes it. A subsequent
DSH generation returns the matching tool result and resumes "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"the **same** ACP
prompt. Parallel calls, sequential tool rounds, failures and permission denials
are"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" supported. A denied action stays denied; no bypass is attempted by the plugin."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"ACP's native tool notifications are never re-executed in DSH. Bridge calls are
identified by the off"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"icial server's MCP metadata. Only permission to reach this
bridge is allowed, once per request; actu"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"al tool execution still belongs to DSH.
Native Antigravity tools outside the bridge cause cancellati"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"on and an explicit
error. YOLO mode, client filesystem and client terminal capabilities stay off.
Th"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"e official executable is an agent, so these protocol guardrails **are not an
OS sandbox** and cannot"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" undo a native action performed before its notification."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"DSH remains the history authority. Independent turns start from full DSH context.
Version 0.3.3 also"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" lets requests without tools borrow a ready server process.
The first such request can claim the sti"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ll-empty model-discovery session once,
avoiding redundant process startup and session creation. Late"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"r independent turns
receive fresh ACP sessions; tool turns always receive their own MCP bridge.
At m"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ost two completed processes stay ready for five minutes, then shut down.
Cancellation, errors and ea"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"rly stream termination discard the affected process.
This is automatic; no extra setup is required. "},{"id":"p20s7","text":"Two real Flash Low samples per
version measured 18–21 seconds to first text in 0.3.2 versus 8.7–9.2 "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"seconds in
the 0.3.3 candidate for the first request without tools after discovery. These
small samp"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"les are not a latency guarantee. Cold startup, fresh sessions, model
selection and Google's generati"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"on time can still take longer.
See the timing record."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Only an unfinished tool round trip retains ACP state. Context/model/catalog

All sibling runtime files are preserved. The cache is under
`$DS"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"H_HOME/cache/antigravity-acp`, or `~/.cache/dsh-antigravity-acp` outside DSH.
Complete caches are re"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"used; incomplete/corrupt downloads retry automatically.
Downloads require ordinary HTTPS verificatio"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"n, reject redirects and validate ZIP
paths/types/sizes. The Registry supplies no checksum; no vendor"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" signature is
invented. Google binaries are not bundled or redistributed. No postinstall script."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"OAuth uses only the official server's advertised oauth-personal method. The
